title: Major disaster declaration DR-4903-SD: Straight-Line Winds
summary: FEMA records a major disaster declaration (DR-4903-SD, "STRAIGHT-LINE WINDS") for SD, dated 2026-04-07, for an incident of type "Straight-Line Winds". The incident period began on 2025-12-17 and ended on 2025-12-18. The declaration lists 3 designated areas.
